text: Cigfa, whom some call Kigva, was a Welsh heroine or goddess within the Mabinogion's tales. She wed Pryderi, the child of goddess Rhiannon and her mate Pwyll. In the third branch her husband was seized with his mother inside a magical Fairy Mound. A spell confined them there. After their capture, Cigfa lived chastely with Rhiannon's second husband, Manawydan. She stayed faithful while Manawydan searched for a way to break the spell on their spouses. In the end he found a path to lift the enchantment.

okr.objective: Cigfa, a Welsh heroine, held to her marriage while Manawydan worked to free their spouses from a Fairy Mound.
